thread:
marta: Kickoff idea for the enrichment extraction: rather than big-bang, we standardize a 'thin-adapter' pattern for interim routing. Goal: quick extract with provable rollback + automatic garbage collection of adapters. low ceremony.
lee: Love the approach. Key constraints: adapters must be stateless, expose explicit contract, and have a TTL removal ticket created at PR time.
oliver: Operational bits: adapters behind feature flags, with circuit-breaker defaults and per-tenant pinning. Router needs header rule and % rollout support.
priya: Can we require an integration smoke test that runs in the CI pipeline and validates parity on a small sample? If mismatch >2% fail the job.
marta: Yes. Parity check = sample request set + checksum comparison + error delta threshold. We'll record samples in a small bucket for postmortem.
lee: Suggest adapters carry versioned metadata in headers eg `X-Adapter-Version: enrich-adapter.v1` and also a `X-Adapter-Owner` so we can contact owner quickly.
oliver: For rollback: automatic flow is -> detect sustained errors -> flip flag off -> router routes to legacy -> increase sampling to verify. Ops runbook should include exact thresholds.
priya: Proposed thresholds: 3m sustained >=5xx rate of 10% OR >30% errors in 1m sliding window -> immediate flag rollback. Postmortem within 48h.
devops-bot: deploy pipeline queued: ref-enrich/adapter v0.1 -> staging (ci-7821). Logs at https://ci/ref-enrich/7821
marta: Safety lint idea: disallow direct calls to internal-only hostnames from adapter code. We'll add a simple static grep + CI enforcement. 
lee: Also require idempotency contract for any adapter that retries. Document expected idempotency keys and TTLs.
priya: Metrics to define: enrichment.adapter.success_rate, enrichment.adapter.latency_p50/p95, enrichment.parity_mismatch_ratio, enrichment.adapter.active_tenants. Dashboards + alerting.
oliver: On the router side we need a 'shadow' mode where adapter gets traffic mirrored but not in-path to validate without affecting traffic. Useful pre-canary.
marta: Good call. Mirror mode + header pinning + fractional rollout covers most risk cases.
lee: Cleanup governance: each adapter PR must create a removal ticket like `debt/remove-enrich-adapter-<owner>` with an explicit date and automation to file stale-nag reminders.
priya: Test infra: add a lightweight harness `integration/enrich_adapter_playground` that can be run locally and in CI. Include canned fixtures.
oliver: Runbook: on sustained alarm -> flip flag -> scale adapter replicas to zero -> route to legacy -> notify #eng-oncall and paging list. Owner responsibility to triage within 30m.
marta: Action items: marta -> draft playbook doc + example router rule; lee -> lint prototype to block internal endpoints; oliver -> add router header pin & mirror support + small integration; priya -> parity harness + CI step; devops-bot -> kick a staging deploy and run canary suite. Sync tomorrow 11:00 for canary results. :rocket:
